_comment: Hand-curated deals tracker shown on the Deals page. Not written by the pipeline: edit by hand. Every deal must carry at least one primary source (company release, SEC filing or regulator) and a 'verified' date; scripts/test_deals.mjs enforces the rules below in CI and the page hides any entry that breaks them. Status follows what a source says: a deal stays 'pending' until a source confirms completion. Sizes are as the source states them; usd_bn is set only when a source gives a US dollar figure, and is never converted here.
scope: Signed or completed transactions involving Bermuda life & annuity reinsurers, their sponsors and their cedants, announced or completed since 1 January 2025.
vetting: At least one primary source: the company's own release, an SEC filing, or a regulator document.
Facts on the card (parties, size, dates, status) come from those sources; independent coverage is linked where it adds detail.
A deal is listed only once it is signed. Reports of talks or exploratory sales are left out until a party confirms them.
Status is 'Closed' only when a source confirms completion; until then it stays 'Pending', and the card says when it was last checked.

excluded.title: Apollo exploring a sale of Catalina Holdings' UK arm
excluded.reason: Press report of an exploratory process (The Insurer); nothing signed or confirmed by Apollo or Catalina.

deals.title: Talcott reinsures $6.3bn of Lincoln Financial GUL and funding agreements
deals.summary: A Talcott subsidiary reinsures about $5.8bn of in-force guaranteed universal life statutory reserves (about 37% of Lincoln's remaining GUL block) plus about $500m of funding agreement business, partly as coinsurance with funds withheld and partly as modco. Lincoln keeps administration and put the all-in statutory capital impact at about $200m. With its 2023 Fortitude Re deal, about 60% of Lincoln's GUL block is now reinsured.

sources.label: Announcement
Closing release
Lincoln closes $6.3bn reinsurance transaction with Talcott

deals.title: Fortitude Re buys Dayforward's platform to build Fortitude Life
deals.summary: Fortitude Re's parent, FGH Parent, L.P., is buying substantially all of insurtech Dayforward's assets (technology platform, distribution agreements, IP, licensed agency and staff) into a new subsidiary to be renamed Fortitude Life. Dayforward's insurance entities and legacy policies are excluded. Gives Fortitude Re its own annuity origination platform.
deals.note: Price not disclosed. The release does not say whether the purchase has completed.

sources.label: Fortitude Re Acquires Dayforward to Broaden Capabilities
Fortitude Re acquires insurtech Dayforward
Fortitude Re advances long-term strategy with Dayforward acquisition

deals.title: Prismic to reinsure a further $5bn of Prudential's Japanese whole life
deals.summary: Prismic will reinsure about $5bn of reserves backing USD-denominated Japanese whole life policies written by Prudential's Japanese affiliates; Prudential keeps its policyholder obligations and administration. Prismic expects to manage about $25bn of assets supporting assumed liabilities once it closes. Subject to regulatory approvals.

sources.label: Prismic Life Announces $5 Billion Reinsurance Agreement with Prudential Financial
Investor relations copy
Prismic expands Japanese business with $5bn deal

deals.title: Sun Life and Wilton Re form the Windsor Life Re partnership
deals.summary: Wilton Re will set up and manage Windsor Life Re, a US- and Bermuda-domiciled reinsurer supporting its in-force life and annuity block origination in the US, with Sun Life's SLC Management as lead asset manager. About $900m of equity, with Sun Life and Wilton Re each contributing roughly a third; expected to start with a ~$1.7bn in-force block and grow to ~$10bn of assets at scale.
deals.note: Launch expected in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory approvals.

Wilton Re copy of the release
Wilton Re and Sun Life partner on new life & annuity reinsurance vehicle
Sun Life and Wilton Re in strategic partnership

deals.title: Sixth Street to become majority shareholder of Monument Re
deals.summary: Vehicles managed or advised by Sixth Street agreed to take a majority stake in the Bermuda-based pan-European insurance consolidator, bringing fresh capital. Hannover Re stays a key shareholder and Monument keeps operating as a standalone company.
deals.note: Financial terms not disclosed. Expected to close by the end of 2026, subject to regulatory approvals.

Sixth Street copy of the release
Sixth Street agrees to take majority stake in Monument Re

deals.title: Prismic Life closes $1.9bn oversubscribed capital raise
deals.summary: Prismic, the Bermuda reinsurer sponsored by Prudential and Warburg Pincus, closed its raise at about $1.9bn of total commitments, above its original $1.6bn target. It says it has now raised more than $3.3bn in total and manages over $17bn of liabilities, including Prudential's US and Japanese blocks and third-party business such as the Dai-ichi Life transaction.

deals.title: Dai-ichi Life reinsures a yen whole life and annuity block with Prismic
deals.summary: Prismic Life Reinsurance International agreed to reinsure an in-force, yen-denominated block of whole life and annuity policies from Dai-ichi Life, which keeps its policyholder obligations and administration. Prismic's May 2026 capital-raise release cites the Dai-ichi transaction.
deals.note: Size not disclosed. Announcement date from Reinsurance News coverage; completion not confirmed in a source.

deals.title: Brookfield Wealth Solutions acquires Just Group
deals.summary: BWS bought UK pension risk transfer and retirement specialist Just Group plc by court-sanctioned scheme of arrangement, at a ~75% premium to the undisturbed price. Shareholders approved on 19 Sep 2025 and the PRA and FCA cleared it. BWS plans to combine Just with its UK insurer Blumont under the Just brand; Brookfield says the deal adds about $40bn of insurance assets.

milestones.event: Completed; Just delisted from the LSE

deals.title: Talcott adds ¥100bn to its Japan Post Insurance block
deals.summary: Expansion of the 2025 transaction: Talcott reinsures an additional ¥100bn block of in-force payout annuities from Japan Post Insurance, effective 31 Mar 2026. Japan Post Insurance continues to service and administer the policies.

sources.label: Talcott Financial Group Expands Block Reinsurance Transaction with Japan Post Insurance by ¥100 Billion

deals.title: Athora acquires Pension Insurance Corporation
deals.summary: Athora, the Apollo-affiliated European savings and retirement group, bought 100% of Pension Insurance Corporation Group, a top-three UK pension risk transfer insurer that keeps its brand. PRA approval came on 6 Mar 2026. Athora also plans to move its corporate and legal headquarters from Bermuda to the UK by late 2027, subject to approvals.

Athora to acquire Pension Insurance Corporation Group

deals.title: Corebridge and Equitable agree an all-stock merger
deals.summary: The two will combine under a new parent operating as Equitable (NYSE: EQH): 1.0 new share per Corebridge share and 1.55516 per Equitable share, for about 51% / 49% ownership. Combined ~$1.5tn of assets under management and administration and 12m+ customers, with over $500m of synergies targeted by 2028.
deals.note: Expected to close by year-end 2026; regulatory approvals outstanding as of the stockholder-approval release.

deals.title: Ancient Financial buys F&G Life Re

size.text: $1.8bn in-force block ceded with the entity

deals.summary: Newly launched Ancient Financial bought F&G's Bermuda reinsurer F&G Life Re Ltd, renamed Ancient Re, taking the remaining $1.8bn in-force block with it. F&G adds Ancient Re as a forward-flow reinsurance partner; F&G said the unit was no longer needed to support its reinsurance strategy.

deals.title: Sagicor combines Sagicor Group Jamaica and Sagicor Life Inc.
deals.summary: Sagicor Financial agreed to combine two subsidiaries under a new holding company, Sagicor Group Caribbean, with about US$6.9bn of pro forma assets and US$1.3bn of revenues; SFC expects to own about 55%. Conditions include regulatory approvals, SGJ shareholder approval and SGJ raising financing, including new investment from Pan Jamaica Group.
deals.note: SGJ shareholders meet on 28 Oct 2026; management has said closing could slip into the first half of 2027.

deals.title: Talcott reinsures $10bn of MetLife US retail variable annuities
deals.summary: Talcott Resolution Life Insurance Company reinsures about $10bn of MetLife's US retail variable annuity and rider reserves on a modco and funds-withheld basis; MetLife keeps administration. MetLife valued the deal at about $250m (ceding commission plus capital released over time) and said it cuts VA account values by about 40%.

deals.title: Aquarian to take Brighthouse Financial private
deals.summary: Aquarian, parent of Bermuda reinsurer Somerset Re, agreed to buy Brighthouse for $70 a share in cash; Brighthouse keeps its name, Charlotte headquarters and CEO. Stockholders approved on 12 Feb 2026, the HSR waiting period expired, and FINRA and CFIUS cleared it.
deals.note: As of the Q2 2026 10-Q only insurance approvals in Delaware, New York and Massachusetts remained; the outside date extends automatically to 6 Dec 2026.

deals.title: Nippon Life takes full ownership of Resolution Life

size.text: $8.2bn for the remaining shares (values Resolution Life at $10.6bn)

deals.summary: Nippon Life, already a minority shareholder, bought the rest of Resolution Life from its investment limited partnership. The US, UK, Bermuda and Singapore institutional business becomes a Nippon Life subsidiary; the Australasian business merges with Nippon's MLC to form the Acenda joint venture. Sir Clive Cowdery stays as chair and CEO.

deals.title: Athene to reinsure a Sony Life US-dollar whole life block
deals.summary: Athene intends to reinsure an in-force block of USD-denominated whole life policies from Sony Life and retrocede all of the block's mortality risk to Swiss Re. It is Athene's eighth reinsurance transaction across seven cedents and its second block deal with a Japanese insurer, taking its Japan cedant volume to about $19bn.
deals.note: Block size not disclosed separately. No completion announcement found.

sources.label: Athene Announces Block Reinsurance Transaction with Sony Life in Japan
Athene announces block reinsurance transaction with Japanese insurer Sony Life

deals.title: F&G starts a flow partnership with Blackstone-backed Fort Greene Re
deals.summary: F&G cedes certain fixed indexed annuities on a coinsurance funds-withheld quota share basis, and certain funding agreements on a modco basis, to Fort Greene Reinsurance SPC (Segregated Portfolio No. 1), effective 1 Aug 2025. F&G holds no stake in the vehicle, which supports its shift to a capital-light model.
deals.note: Agreement effective 1 Aug 2025, announced 6 Aug. Artemis reports the vehicle is Cayman Islands-based.

deals.title: Japan Post Insurance commits $2bn to a Global Atlantic co-investment vehicle
deals.summary: Japan Post Insurance, KKR and Global Atlantic signed definitive agreements for Japan Post Insurance to invest $2bn in a new Global Atlantic-sponsored vehicle, over half its capital, to take part in insurance, reinsurance and strategic transactions. KKR's 10-Q confirms the $2bn commitment; trade press names the investor.
deals.note: Vehicle expected to start operating in the first half of 2026, subject to regulatory approval; start not confirmed in a source.

deals.title: MetLife cedes ~$10bn to new Bermuda reinsurer Chariot Re
deals.summary: Chariot Re, a Bermuda Class E life and annuity reinsurer co-sponsored by MetLife and General Atlantic (about 15% each) with Chubb as lead investor, launched by reinsuring about $10bn of MetLife structured settlement and PRT-related group annuity liabilities. MetLife Investment Management and General Atlantic are its exclusive asset managers; MetLife keeps all customer functions.

Effective 31 Mar 2025; Talcott's second transaction with a Japanese insurer. AM Best left the Talcott subsidiaries' ratings unchanged.

deals.summary: RGA reinsures 75% of Equitable's in-force individual life liabilities and widens the partnership into underwriting, product, distribution and investment management. RGA expected to deploy about $1.5bn of capital at closing; Equitable said the deal frees over $2bn of deployable capital. The coinsurance agreements are effective 1 Apr 2025.

deals.title: Prudential reinsures a $7bn Japanese whole life block with Prismic
deals.summary: Prismic, the Bermuda reinsurer sponsored by Prudential and Warburg Pincus, reinsures about $7bn of reserves on USD-denominated whole life policies written by Prudential's Japanese affiliates. Prudential invested about $100m more in Prismic to keep its ~20% stake, alongside ~$400m from other investors.
deals.note: Prudential's 2025 annual report says the transaction completed in March 2025, effective 1 March.
